title: Warmly Aerated Malaysian Leek Satay
description: A diabetic-friendly Malaysian dish featuring leek, agemono-deep-fry, and a jammy, aerated texture, reminiscent of nostalgic Malaysian cuisine. This dish is carefully crafted to be both delicious and healthy.
instructions: Heat the peanut oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, blend the coconut milk, satay seasoning, garlic, and ginger until smooth.
Add the leeks to the blender and blend until they are well coated with the coconut milk mixture.
Carefully add the leek mixture to the hot oil and deep-fry for 3-4 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove the leeks from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice and salt.
Drizzle the lime juice mixture over the deep-fried leeks and serve immediately.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as cilantro or scallions, if desired.
